description: This file defines the interface IStorageFaultGrain within the Orleans.TestingHost namespace. The interface declares methods for injecting and handling storage faults (exceptions) during grain storage operations such as read, write, and clear, for testing purposes.

classes.name: IStorageFaultGrain
classes.description: An interface for a grain that manages storage exception injection for testing purposes.

methods.name: AddFaultOnRead
methods.description: Schedules a storage exception to be thrown on read operations for a specific grain.

methods.name: AddFaultOnWrite
methods.description: Schedules a storage exception to be thrown on write operations for a specific grain.

methods.name: AddFaultOnClear
methods.description: Schedules a storage exception to be thrown when clearing state for a specific grain.

methods.name: OnRead
methods.description: Triggers exception for reading storage if previously scheduled.

methods.name: OnWrite
methods.description: Triggers exception for writing storage if previously scheduled.

methods.name: OnClear
methods.description: Triggers exception for clearing storage if previously scheduled.
